data.name: Fidelity
data.gender_notes: Fidelity is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'fidelis', meaning faithful or loyal. In Christian tradition, Fidelity represents steadfastness in faith and unwavering commitment to God and one's beliefs. The name Fidelity carries the meaning “Loyalty, faithfulness” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Fidelity usually hope their child will grow to embody loyalty, faithfulness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of unwavering trust and commitment to one's spiritual journey and values.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fidelity total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: אמונה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אמונה היא מילה עברית שמשמעותה נאמנות, אמת והתמסרות לאל. היא מושג מרכזי ביהדות ובנצרות, המתאר את היחס בין האדם לאלוהים. המילה אמונה נגזרת מהשורש אמן, שפירושו להיות יציב, נאמן ואמין. בהקשר הרוחני, אמונה מתארת את היחס של האדם לאל, והיא כוללת את האמון באל, בנאמנותו ובהתמסרותו לו.

in_greek.name: Πίστις
in_greek.long_meaning: Πίστις είναι η ελληνική λέξη που σημαίνει πίστη, εμπιστοσύνη και αφοσίωση. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, η πίστη αναφέρεται στη σχέση μεταξύ του ανθρώπου και του Θεού. Η λέξη πίστης προέρχεται από το ρήμα πιστεύω, που σημαίνει να πιστεύω ή να εμπιστεύομαι. Η πίστη είναι μια από τις σημαντικότερες αρετές στη χριστιανική παράδοση και αναφέρεται στην εμπιστοσύνη και την αφοσίωση στον Θεό.

in_latin.name: Fidelitas
in_latin.long_meaning: Fidelitas est Latinum nomen quod significat fidelitatem, devotionem et constantiam. In ecclesia primitiva, fidelitas erat virtus quae describebat relationem inter hominem et Deum. Nomen fidelitas derivatur a verbo fidere, quod significat esse fideliter et devotum. Fidelitas est virtus christiana quae describit devotionem et constantiam in fide.

in_english.name: Fidelity
in_english.meaning: Faithfulness, loyalty, and devotion to God or a person
in_english.long_meaning: Fidelity is a Christian name that originates from the Latin word 'fidelitas,' meaning faithfulness, loyalty, and devotion. The name is rooted in the Hebrew concept of 'emunah' (אמונה) and the Greek concept of 'pistis' (Πίστις), both of which convey the idea of trust, loyalty, and devotion to God. In Christian tradition, fidelity is considered a virtue that describes the relationship between a person and God, characterized by faithfulness, loyalty, and commitment. The name Fidelity is often associated with positive personality traits such as loyalty, dedication, and sincerity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Fidelity is associated with loyalty and faithfulness, which are highly valued traits in Christian culture. It is a reminder of the importance of remaining true to one's beliefs and commitments, both in personal relationships and in one's spiritual journey.
data.spiritual_significance: Fidelity holds deep spiritual significance for Christians as it represents the unwavering loyalty and commitment to God. It is a call to live a life of faithfulness, not only to God, but also to others, and to the teachings and beliefs of the Christian faith. It is a reminder that our relationship with God is a sacred bond that requires a lifelong commitment to remain faithful and obedient to His will.
